consumerClosure.fresh: packaged_installer_target -> installer_browser_module.prepare/start and installer_browser_gateway -> existing operations.browser_session + ordinary MCP provider. No gateway admin tools assigned to Eva.
consumerClosure.recipe: Exact provenance.files -> copied/explicit instance network substitutions -> stopped immutable container native overlay/auth patch -> controlled firewall -> existing controller revision/start -> optional gateway catalog/token.
consumerClosure.recovery: Existing UID1000 retained pair prepare_recovery -> root-owned install manifest/templates -> root firewall helper -> administrator existing controller. No browser-container/agent/tool-call start/replay from service recovery.
consumerClosure.dynamicHelper: installer_browser_gateway/provision_workspace_provider load exact hash-bound development validation helper; metadata registered in operator-support report, coordinator owns package closure.
consumerClosure.boundary: Recovery scripts use delivered fixed legacy chain names and UID1000 retained configuration; fresh installer uses rendered namespace chains/root staging. Recovery subdirectory is not copied by prepare_browser_module. No fresh/reboot capability is inferred; plan explicitly host_reboot_recovery_verified=false.

limitations: Scoped source/provenance review only; current service/host reboot/owner session acceptance not measured. Historical README checkpoints preserved, no new success claimed.
No private profile/state/token/password/current user browser data read.
Vendor seccomp and license content assessed from hashes/source/version/license/build consumer; no full_content label.
